title: Political Economics of Marxism and Leninism

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to analyze economic theories based on Marxist and Leninist principles.
Understanding market dynamics and the roles of various market participants.
Comprehension of surplus value production within a market economy.
Knowledge of competition and monopoly within a market economy.
Understanding of a socialist market economy and its economic relationships.
Insight into industrialization, modernization, and international economic integration.
